name: Brand, Greater (Kobold Press/Open Design)
body:
School transmutation; Level inquisitor 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 day/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts just like brand, with the following changes. Creatures who worship the same god as you are unfriendly toward the target of this spell if they can see the brand. You also gain a +4 sacred bonus to checks to track the target.
